Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer states that the construction of the tallest building in the world as of January 1, 2024, took 69 months. The Predicted Answer identifies the building correctly (Burj Khalifa) and provides an estimated construction time of 72 months (6 years), which is close to but not exactly the same as the ground truth of 69 months. While both answers refer to the same building and timeframe, the specific value differs (72 vs 69). Since the instruction is to determine if the ground truth answer (69) is present in the predicted answer, and the predicted answer only states 72, the ground truth value is not present.
